description: Creates an event and returns it (id, htmlLink, start/end, attendees, hangoutLink when add_meet). Times: EITHER start_date_time + end_date_time (RFC3339; add time_zone for recurring events) OR start_date + end_date for all-day (end_date is EXCLUSIVE — the day after the last day). recurrence makes it a recurring series. attendees invites guests — but the API sends invitation emails ONLY with send_updates=all (the default notifies nobody). add_meet attaches a Google Meet link (may come back status=pending — re-run get_event for the final URL). This is a plain calendar write: it does not check for conflicts — call query_free_busy first to find a free slot. Never blindly re-send after a timeout or 5xx: the event may already exist — check with list_events first, or you will create a duplicate and re-invite everyone.

add_meet.description: Attach a Google Meet conference. The returned conferenceData may be status=pending — re-run get_event for the final Meet link.

attendees.description: Guest list. On update this REPLACES the whole list — fetch the event first and send the complete new list. Invitation emails go out only with send_updates=all.

calendar_id.description: The calendar id from list_calendars, or "primary" for the authenticated user's main calendar.

color_id.description: Event color id ("1".."11"; the palette is fixed by Google).

description.description: Event description (plain text or simple HTML).

end_date.description: All-day event end date, EXCLUSIVE — the day after the last day (a one-day event on the 5th ends on the 6th).

end_date_time.description: Timed event end, RFC3339. Pair with start_date_time.

guests_can_invite_others.description: Whether guests may invite more people.

guests_can_modify.description: Whether guests may edit the event.

guests_can_see_other_guests.description: Whether guests can see the guest list.

location.description: Free-form location, e.g. a room name or address.

recurrence.description: RRULE/RDATE/EXRULE/EXDATE lines (RFC 5545) making the event recurring, e.g. ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE"]. Requires the timed pair plus time_zone.

reminders.description: Custom reminders (max 5). Setting this turns default reminders off for the event.

minutes.description: Minutes before the event start (0..40320 = 4 weeks).

send_updates.description: Who receives an email about this change: all guests, only guests outside your organization, or nobody. Defaults to none — attendees are NOT notified unless you pass all.

start_date.description: All-day event start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pair with end_date.

start_date_time.description: Timed event start, RFC3339 (e.g. 2026-09-01T10:00:00+02:00 or ...Z). Pair with end_date_time.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for start/end (e.g. "Europe/Berlin"). REQUIRED for recurring events; otherwise optional when the RFC3339 offsets already say everything.

transparency.description: opaque = the event blocks time in free/busy (default); transparent = it does not (shows as free).

use_default_reminders.description: Use the calendar's default reminders (ignored when reminders[] is given).

visibility.description: Who can see event details on a shared calendar.

name: create_event
title: Create an event
